data.title: 信浓 · 晨光寝榻的慵懒唤醒
data.description: 清晨和风寝殿内晨光微亮，信浓在蓬松的被窝中睡眼惺忪。如瀑银发漫散一榻，她迷迷糊糊地伸出雪白双臂要晨安抱抱，身后九条大尾巴无意识地卷住你的脚踝撒娇。
data.location: traditional tatami bedroom bathed in soft morning daylight
data.action: sleepily waking up on soft futon, stretching arms for a morning hug, half-lidded golden eyes, fluffy fox tails curling playfully around partner ankles
data.lighting: serene soft morning sunlight filtering through shoji screen
data.mood: adorable sleepiness, cozy domestic snuggling, gentle affection
data.promptProse: Waking up drowsily on a futon in morning light, Shinano stretches out her arms for a hug with her fluffy tails wrapped around partner ankles.
data.animaCaption: Shinano waking up drowsily on a tatami futon stretching for a hug.
